crossRefs.note: Judah went up, and Yahweh delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in…
They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
Samuel arose, and went from Gilgal to Gibeah of Benjamin. Saul counted the people who were present with him, about six…
Saul summoned the people, and counted them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.
Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant…
Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.

parallels.note: even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
translations.bsb: And when Saul numbered them at Bezek, there were 300,000 Israelites and 30,000 men of Judah.
translations.kjv: And when he numbered them in Bezek, the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
translations.asv: And he numbered them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
